notes:
Diagnosis: the desync is NOT the parser losing sync on the error reply. It is that runDeferred only handles a handful of commands (protocol_version, name, version, known_command, list_commands, boardsize, weizigo-stats, quit). When boardsize fails to find an artifact, the session stays in deferred mode where all play commands (clear_board, komi, genmove, showboard, etc.) fall through to the else → unknown command branch. The session is alive but the 'command table' is incomplete.

Fixes applied to src/gtp.zig:
1. runSession boardsize handler (~line 1442): error message now names the fixed goban size, e.g. 'unacceptable size — this engine is fixed to 4x4'
2. runDeferred boardsize handler (~line 2081): error message now says no artifact found and shows the command form, e.g. 'unacceptable size — no artifact for 4x4 found; start with: weizigo-gtp <path-to-wzo>'
3. runDeferred boardsize parse-failure handler (~line 2003): error message now shows the command form, e.g. 'unacceptable size — start with: weizigo-gtp <path-to-wzo>'
4. runDeferred: added clear_board handler (graceful no-op) and showboard handler (informative message: 'no goban loaded — use boardsize N to load an artifact') so the session remains alive after a rejected boardsize

Deferred mode kept (not removed): no tests depend on it, but it serves as a discoverable-on-connect diagnostic surface. The improved error messages make the fix discoverable.

Regression script wired into zig build test at tools/regression-gtp-boardsize.sh: 4 controls, all pass.

final_score reports provisional mid-game with dead stones counted as alive — correct under C2 as-stands ruling (T400), not fixed.

Landmark: advances L0 (the table and instruments exist) — the first thing a human hits when connecting the solved 4x4 engine to a real GUI now surfaces an actionable error message instead of a dead session.
